Subject: Air-gapped deployment onboarding — next steps

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're moving ahead with the air-gapped install at our Texas research facility and need a concise onboarding checklist and the expected signer/courier workflow so our compliance team can prepare. Key asks from our side:
- What artifacts will arrive (full image, delta, manifests)?
- Who signs the manifest on Redwood's side vs. ours?
- Expected window for courier acceptance and operator handoff.
- KMS/HSM integration notes for key custody (we use AWS CloudHSM).

Jane Park

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Air-gapped deployment onboarding — next steps

Hi Jane — great to connect earlier. Attaching our onboarding checklist and a canonical signing manifest for your intake team. High-level answers below; see attachments for details.

Artifacts we deliver:
- Full signed bundle (tar.gz) + signing manifest (CSV) + operator installation guide (PDF).
- Delta patches are delivered as separate signed delta bundles (optional cadence).

Signer responsibilities:
- Redwood will sign the bundle using our offline signing key; the signing manifest enumerates artifact checksums and signer fingerprint.
- On acceptance, Acme operator signs the manifest as "accepted on site"; that signature is recorded in the manifest and on the acceptance form.

Courier/Acceptance window:
- Standard acceptance window: 09:00–13:00 local on the scheduled day.
- Operator must validate signature and manifest before powering the appliance.

KMS/HSM notes:
- We do not ship private keys. If you require CloudHSM-backed verification, we can provide verifier toolchains and guidance to import signer public keys into your KMS.

Attachments included: mina_onboarding_checklist.pdf, signing_manifest.csv, courier-instructions.pdf

Next steps:
1) Review checklist + sample manifest.
2) Confirm preferred courier window and operator contact.
3) Schedule a 30m dry-run acceptance call with your operator, our operations lead (Jonas), and security (Evelyn).

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Head of Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
[attachment: mina_onboarding_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@acmeenergy.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Air-gapped deployment onboarding — next steps

Hi all — quick security clarifications before the dry run: 

1) Manifest format: please confirm your ingestion tool accepts SHA256 checksums and a signer_fingerprint field. Our CSV has columns: filename, size_bytes, sha256, signer_fingerprint, timestamp.
2) Notarization: Do you require an independent notarization (third-party timestamp) for the signer? If yes, we can coordinate an RFC for that process but it will add 3–5 business days.
3) HSM verification: If Acme wants to verify signatures using CloudHSM, we recommend importing our public verification key and running the verifier in your isolated environment. We'll provide a small verifier binary and reproducible build instructions.
4) Emergency rollback: please confirm operator rollback path (we need a signed rollback bundle or a signed revocation list).

I propose we document these in the acceptance call and record a short signature verification runbook in Drive. 

Evelyn Hart
Security Director — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
[signature block]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Jane / Acme ops team — thanks. Below is an operational timeline and acceptance checklist we expect to run through on the dry run. Please review and confirm operator name/phone.

Operational timeline (dry run):
- T-5 days: Redwood prepares signed bundle and manifest; we upload verification artifacts to the shared Drive link.
- T-2 days: ColdCourier collects package from our staging facility (signed chain of custody attached).
- Day 0 (Acceptance day): Courier delivers between 09:00–13:00. Operator validates manifest, runs the verifier, and signs the acceptance form.
- T+1 day: Redwood requests photo of signed manifest and operator-signed acceptance PDF (for audit).

Acceptance checklist (short):
- Confirm filenames and SHA256 match manifest.
- Run verifier binary: exit code 0 and "signature OK" output.
- Confirm operator identity (photo of badge + operator-signed acceptance PDF).
- Verify revocation list (no revocations for delivered signer key).

Attachments: manifest-sample.txt (sample CSV), courier-instructions.pdf (courier handling and cold-chain requirements).

Please reply with the operator contact and preferred acceptance date. We can do a dry-run on 2025-09-18 if that works.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Lead Operations Engineer, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
